title: Training Notes — Recorded Remaining Deductible and the Card-on-File Charge, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Rule taught.** The deductible part of a card-on-file charge on the Patient Financial Account is limited by the account's recorded remaining deductible:

1. when the remaining deductible recorded on the account is above 0.00 and the coverage verified date recorded on the account is no more than the tier's re-verification period, in calendar days, before the handling date, the covered deductible lines count only up to the recorded remaining deductible;
2. when the recorded remaining deductible is above 0.00 and the coverage verified date is older than that, the covered deductible lines count as 0.00;
3. when the recorded remaining deductible is 0.00, no limit applies under this rule.

The re-verification period of each class, in calendar days: Medicaid Managed Care Account 30; Self-Pay Account 90; Medicare Part B Account 365; Medicare Advantage Account 90; Commercial HMO/EPO Account 90; Commercial PPO/POS Account 90; High-Deductible Health Plan Account 90.

The covered deductible lines are the deductible lines of the encounter being charged that the card-on-file charge covers; coinsurance lines are not touched by this rule.

## Questions from training

**Q. What does "no more than the period before the handling date" mean at the edge?** On a class with a 90-day period, a verification dated exactly 90 days before the handling date is within it; one dated 91 days before is older than it.

**Q. Worked case, verification current (hypothetical figures).** Covered deductible lines 420.00, recorded remaining deductible 260.00, verified 40 days ago on a 90-day class: the deductible lines count as 260.00.

**Q. Worked case, verification stale (hypothetical figures).** The same account verified 91 days ago: the deductible lines count as 0.00, whatever the recorded remaining deductible.

**Q. Worked case, deductible met.** Recorded remaining deductible 0.00: the rule sets no limit, whatever the verification date.

| Recorded remaining deductible | Verification age against the class period | Covered deductible lines count as |
|---|---|---|
| above 0.00 | within the period | up to the recorded remaining deductible |
| above 0.00 | older than the period | 0.00 |
| 0.00 | any | not limited by this rule |
